execution.final_publication: After every chunk passes full validation and sidecar verification, invoke the exact frozen v094x run() only for checkpoint replay, aggregation, parent-signature replay and atomic final publication.

frozen_science_runner.rule: Workers import and call the exact frozen v094x process_pair implementation; no scientific function or threshold is copied or modified.

r3_repairs.initial_schedule_interrupt: The first schedule() call is inside the same KeyboardInterrupt/drain handler as the main loop; partial submissions are cancelled/drained/checkpointed on interrupt.
r3_repairs.memory_measurement_failure: OpenProcess/GetProcessMemoryInfo failure is an explicit resource HOLD carrying PID, failed API stage and Windows error code; never substitute zero memory.
r3_repairs.preflight_only: Optional --preflight-only / -PreflightOnly runs full checkpoint validation/adoption, 8-worker equivalence and resource gate, then exits before unseen chunks are scheduled.
r3_repairs.zero_future_resource_hold: If a runtime HOLD exists while unfinished work remains but no futures are outstanding, terminate immediately rather than spinning.

all_rows: pair index/key/signature and parent identity fields
valid JSON for observable-distance list and every distance subtotal
per-distance grid-level case totals == per-distance cases
per-distance and aggregate subtotals agree exactly
observable distance list equals distances with observable placements
status is consistent with accounting and DeltaT qualification
checkpoint_integrity.legacy_serial_adoption: Existing serial chunks without sidecars are accepted only after full-row semantic validation, then receive a provenance sidecar. Invalid chunks and sidecars are preserved with timestamp suffixes.
checkpoint_integrity.sidecar: Every accepted checkpoint receives an atomic .meta.json containing CSV SHA256, row count, pair/signature provenance digest, frozen science SHA, execution contract SHA, controller SHA, and hashes of v094t/v094w/v094s parent provenance artifacts.

review_repairs.equivalence_gate: Before unseen work, recompute one representative pair from every already-valid checkpoint chunk using the eight-worker pool and require exact OUTPUT_FIELDS equality to its checkpoint row.
review_repairs.exclusive_controller: Acquire a project-specific Windows named mutex before loading the pool; a second r1/r2 controller is also rejected by the launcher process check.
review_repairs.failure_and_interrupt: Worker exceptions or Ctrl+C stop new submissions, cancel not-started futures, continue collecting successful running results into fully validated checkpoints, record failures, and only then exit HOLD.
review_repairs.remote_publication: Initial and resume paths both push/retry the execution-freeze commit and verify origin/main equals that exact commit before any parallel worker pool is allowed to start.

resources.pre_pool_dynamic_estimate: After the controller loads the same frozen foundation that each worker will load, measure the controller process private bytes and working set. Before spawning eight workers require available physical RAM >= max(4 GiB, 1.15 * 8 * controller working set) and available commit >= max(6 GiB, 1.25 * 8 * controller private bytes), plus the 5 GiB disk floor. Then measure actual eight-worker demand during the equivalence gate before unseen chunks are released.
resources.pre_pool_min_available_commit_gb: dynamic: max(6 GiB, 1.25 × 8 × loaded-controller private bytes)
resources.pre_pool_min_available_physical_gb: dynamic: max(4 GiB, 1.15 × 8 × loaded-controller working set)
resources.release_gate: During the representative-pair gate measure aggregate/peak worker private and working-set memory plus minimum physical/commit headroom. Unseen chunks are not released unless disk >=5 GB, available physical >=2 GB, and available commit >=4 GB after the eight-worker pool is resident.
resources.runtime_hold: On any threshold breach stop submissions immediately, cancel futures that have not started, drain running chunks to validated checkpoints, then exit HOLD.

stop_rule: Same as frozen v094x: stop after the full-population geometry/synthetic validation.
